Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Cognizant Romania is home to 2400+ creative technologists and is one of Eastern Europe's largest Software Product Engineering delivery networks. We serve global clients in several industries, including Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communication Media & Technology, and Retail & MLEU (manufacturing, logistics, energy & utilities).
 Cognizant Romania was established in 2018 when Cognizant acquired Softvision, a company founded in the late 1990s in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We continue to build on our history as the preferred engineering partner for thriving Silicon Valley tech companies, now as a prominent Cognizant next generation studio.
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our team in Bucharest. You will design and deliver scalable data pipelines and high‑performance analytical solutions using S QL/BigQuery, Spark/PySpark, and Python on Google Cloud. This role focuses on building reliable, cloud‑native data products that enable advanced reporting, analytics, and decision‑making across the organization.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Build scalable data pipelines : Design and deliver batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines across cloud environments to support analytics and reporting.
 Develop SQL and BigQuery solutions : Write and optimize advanced SQL transformations and build performant, cost‑efficient BigQuery data models.
 Develop Python workflows : Implement scalable data processing solutions using Python and PySpark, ensuring maintainable and high‑quality code.
 Design data models and ensure quality : Build robust data models and apply validation practices to maintain accuracy and reliability.
 Build cloud ‑ native data solutions : Use GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Pub/Sub, and GCS to build and operate modern data platforms.
 Optimize performance and reliability : Troubleshoot complex pipeline issues and continuously improve compute, storage, and processing performance.
 Collaborate using strong engineering practices : Work with engineering, analytics, and business teams while contributing to CI/CD, code reviews, and testing standards.
 Required Skills and Experience 
 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building scalable data pipelines and working with cloud-based data ecosystems.
Strong expertise in SQL and hands‑on experience building performant datasets in BigQuery (or similar cloud data warehouses).
Proven experience with Python and PySpark for scalable data processing in distributed environments.
Solid understanding of data modeling, ELT/ETL patterns, and data quality best practices.
Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer, GCS, or equivalent cloud data services.
Hands‑on experience building scalable data pipelines (batch and near real‑time) in a cloud‑native environment.
Proficiency with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
Ability to troubleshoot and optimize performance across compute, storage, and processing layers.
 Nice to have: 
Experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform, Ansible, Chef).
Knowledge of shell scripting.
Experience in financial services or regulated environments
 Cognizant Romania Employee Benefits: 
 Flexible Work Schedule – Outside of core working hours, you have the flexibility to arrange your schedule in a way that best suits your personal and professional needs.
 Flexible Hybrid Approach – We support a hybrid working model that helps you balance remote and office work. Employees based near a Cognizant office are expected to spend a minimum of 4 days per month onsite.
 Annual Leave – Enjoy 26 vacation days each year to relax, recharge, travel, and spend quality time with family and friends.
 Learning & Development – Access a wide range of training programs, workshops, certifications, and continuous learning opportunities to support your professional growth.
 Private Medical Insurance – Comprehensive healthcare coverage for your wellbeing and peace of mind.
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential professional support services to help you navigate personal, emotional, financial, legal, or work-related challenges.
 Meal Tickets – Monthly meal allowance provided through meal vouchers.
 Referral Bonus Program – Help us grow our team and be rewarded for successful referrals.
 Life Insurance – Additional protection and financial security
 Banking Benefits – Preferential banking services and financial products through our partner institutions.
 Bookster Library – Access thousands of books, audiobooks, and learning resources to support both personal and professional development.
 Please note that only suitable candidates will be contacted. Cognizant and its affiliated companies are firmly committed to protecting your privacy.
